new_statements.rule_in_words: The SIL phonology data sheet states that Iwal word stress is not predictable by rule and may be contrastive (lexical); no positional default, no examples with stress marked, and no minimal pairs are given.
new_statements.exceptions: none; the statement is a single hedged sentence ('may be phonemic') with no supporting data
new_statements.domain_note: Implicitly the word (OPD suprasegmentals slot); no discussion of phrase-level prominence or citation forms. Four-page data sheet compiled from the Davidsons' 1975-76 unpublished phonemics; 'Data checked by' field is blank.
new_statements.identity_note: The OPD is headed 'Iwal (Kaiwa) Language [KBM], Wau - Morobe Province' = Glottolog iwal1237 / ISO kbm (Kaiwa is the older Jabem-derived exonym). The Davidsons' data come from coastal speakers of Buansing and Salus villages (Bradshaw 2001:51); no dialect differentiation is described.
